title: All Machine Learning Concepts Explained in 22 Minutes
summary: This video gives a rapid tour of the basic vocabulary of machine learning in about 22 minutes. It starts with foundations: AI versus machine learning, algorithms, data, models, training, and the split between training and test data. It then covers the three learning paradigms and the anatomy of a dataset (features, feature engineering, scaling, dimensionality, targets, instances and labels). The core of the video explains model complexity, bias, variance, noise, overfitting and underfitting, and how validation, cross-validation and regularization deal with them. It ends with the mechanics of training (batches, epochs, parameters, hyperparameters, cost functions, gradient descent, learning rate) and model evaluation.
